bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for card error message
steps_to_reproduce: Enter an invalid credit card number and submit the form
Observe the error message displayed in the paragraph with id "card-error"
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The error text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background per WCAG 2.1 AA.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The error text uses color #ff9999 on a white background (#ffffff), resulting in a contrast ratio of 2.04:1, which fails the required threshold.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for #card-error, change color from #ff9999 to #a36262 (4.69:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.04:1, required 4.5:1).

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical

bugLogs.title: Select element #state lacks an accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the state selection dropdown
Attempt to focus the dropdown with keyboard or screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select element must have an accessible name that can be programmatically determined, such as a visible label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <select id="state"> element has no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label and associate it with the select, e.g., <label for="state">State</label> before the <select id="state">, or add aria-label="State" to the select element.

bugLogs.title: Missing persistent labels for checkout form inputs
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the form fields for Name, Email, and Address
Observe that each input only shows placeholder text and has no visible label
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each form input must have a persistent visible label (or an equivalent aria-label/aria-labelledby) that remains visible when the field receives focus.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The inputs #name, #email, and #address rely solely on placeholder text and lack associated <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attributes.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a <label> element for each input and associate it via the for attribute, e.g., <label for="name">Full Name</label><input type="text" id="name" placeholder="Full Name">. Repeat for email and address. If visual design prevents visible labels, add aria-label="Full Name" (and similarly for email and address) to each input.

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical
